Four crewmembers departed the International Space Station on January 14 after a medical issue prompted their mission to be cut a month short -- a first for the orbiting laboratory. articles.image_title: Karibikinsel Bonaire: One of the residents of the Dutch territory off the coast of Venezuela that teamed up with Greenpeace to sue the Dutch government and demand "concrete measures" to shield the island from rising waters, shades a tear outside the courthouse before a court ruled that the Netherlands "insufficiently" protects the tiny Caribbean territory of Bonaire from climate change, in the Hague on January 28, 2026. The ruling by the Hague District Court warned that Bonaire residents "are being treated differently from the inhabitants of the European part of the Netherlands without good reason", calling it a violation of their human rights. The ruling follows an advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice, which found that states violating their climate obligations were committing an "unlawful" act.
